critique.evidence: The section has a polished, cohesive defense-console aesthetic: strong headline hierarchy, disciplined cyan/red/yellow accents, consistent monospaced labels, and a well-structured residual-risk card across all viewports. Tablet and mobile reflow cleanly without section overflow. It falls short of an 8 because the global header degrades visibly: tablet navigation ends in an abrupt “SWIPE →” cutoff, while mobile loses the AI Defense Lab wordmark and red-mode control entirely. Several secondary labels and source/footer lines are extremely small and low-contrast, and the mobile card becomes text-dense with weak separation between its evidence and control blocks.
critique.fix: Preserve a compact brand mark and red-mode affordance on mobile, make horizontal navigation truncation feel intentional with a fade/edge treatment, and increase the size or contrast of microcopy. Add slightly more spacing or a divider between the mobile evidence boundary and next-control blocks.
